- Encrypted Mempool: 80% (Testnet) — BIBE-based encrypted transaction ordering. Hides transaction contents until afte

- Baby Raptr Consensus: 95% (Mainnet) — Merged Jolteon consensus + Quorum Store. Proposer optimistically includes batch 
- Block-STM v2: 60% (Development) — Next-gen parallel execution engine. Improved conflict resolution, better schedul
- MonoMove VM: 40% (Development) — Unified Move VM runtime that combines interpreter, compiler, and framework into 
- Keyless Accounts (AIP-61): 95% (Mainnet) — Social login → blockchain accounts via OIDC + ZK proofs. No private key manageme
- Zaptos (Optimistic Pipelining): 25% (Research) — Start executing transactions BEFORE consensus finalizes. Speculate on likely ord
- Shardines (Internal Sharding): 15% (Research) — Each validator internally shards execution across multiple sub-executors. Target
- Aptos Names Service: 90% (Mainnet (V2)) — Domain name system for Aptos. Maps .apt names to addresses. V2 on Token Objects
